packages.title: Boolean Function Complexity Foundation
packages.summary: A complete exact atlas of every labeled Boolean function on one through four variables, with logical, algebraic, Fourier, query-complexity, symmetry, and relation-closure structure.
packages.details: A research-neutral starting point for finite Boolean-function investigations. The Study combines a complete labeled atlas through four variables with exact descriptors, reproducible providers, and a small formal foundation, while leaving the research question and target to the user.
features: All 65,812 labeled Boolean functions on one through four variables
49 complete exact fields spanning algebraic, Fourier, symmetry, monotonicity, canalization, and query-complexity structure
Dependency-free Python reference provider with a full-corpus C++ parity check
Pinned Study-local Lean foundation with explicitly documented formal scope
limitations: No active target, conjecture, or research history is preloaded
The finite atlas stops at four input variables
packages.license: CC0-1.0 data and metadata; Apache-2.0 software

features: 34,374 canonical reaction networks on two and three species
45 exact fields covering stoichiometry, deficiency, linkage, reversibility, conservation, catalysis, and reaction-graph structure

Pinned Study-local Lean foundation with explicitly documented formal scope

packages.title: Graph Theory Foundation

packages.details: A broad finite graph research foundation built from the compact graph registry.
